facts.text: Serve the drinks when Toulouse brings out the green absinthe.
facts.why: The film has a Green Fairy absinthe scene with the Bohemians, but the Wikipedia plot I opened does not cover it, so I could not confirm that Toulouse is the one who brings the absinthe out. The printed card shows the same cue.
facts.fix: Serve the drinks when the Green Fairy appears over the Bohemians' table.

facts.text: Welcome, darlings! Tonight everything is permitted. Drinks first, tragedy later, and absolutely no talking during the show.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Zidler's words, but it is not a line from the film. I could not open a quote page for this pass (the search tool was out of budget), so there is no quote source.
facts.fix: Welcome, darlings. Drinks first, tragedy later, and not a word during the show. The Duke is paying.
